revision_notes: Fast-path light check surfaced authoritative evidence, so the row was moved to the full path rather than confirmed as Unknown. The DCO Digital Trade Acceleration Initiative country report for The Gambia (published 2025, data current to September 2024) states explicitly that Gambia has no general/economy-wide data localisation mandate, but does require government data classified as 'Classified' to be stored and processed within the country (on a government private cloud or on-premise), with separate rules for data classified 'Sensitive'; this is set out in the national G-Cloud Policy. That G-Cloud Policy document is labelled 'Final Draft' in the government policy repository, so its formal enactment status is not fully confirmed — flagged for human review on that point. Separately, the Personal Data Protection and Privacy Act 2025 (enacted; oversight assigned to the Access to Information Authority/Data Protection Commission) imposes an adequacy/safeguards-based cross-border transfer regime for personal data, GDPR-style, rather than mandatory in-country storage. Given a sectoral (government-data-only) localisation requirement rather than a comprehensive one, the code is revised from 0 (Unknown, unsupported) to 3 (Sectoral requirements only) on the ict-storage-datalocalisation scale.
revised_comments: The Gambia does not impose a general, economy-wide data localisation mandate. Localisation rules apply specifically to government data under the national G-Cloud Policy: data classified as 'Classified' must be stored and processed within the country, either on a government private cloud or on-premise, with separate storage requirements for data classified as 'Sensitive'. Personal data more broadly is instead governed by the Personal Data Protection and Privacy Act 2025, which regulates cross-border transfers through an adequacy and safeguards mechanism rather than requiring in-country storage. Localisation therefore applies to a specific sectoral category (government data) rather than comprehensively across data types.
